sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.448/2022, dated 30.05.2022, registered at Police Station Panagar, District Jabalpur (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 363 and 376 of IPC and under Section 5(L) and 5(N) of POCSO Act.
As prayed by learned counsel for the applicant, this first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C filed on behalf of applicant - Ramswaroop Rajak is dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE AT Ramswaroop Rajak vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142313400/
